steps: Fix f with C(f)<=L^c and set y=f|U_N.
Substitute the f-circuit into every generated query of the XOR carrier; since L=polylog(N), the substituted target-circuit cost is N^{q+o(1)} and the generator cost is N^{rho+o(1)}.
If y is accepted by a functionally sound certificate, then C(H_N^y)>N^{1+epsilon}.
When max{rho,q}<1+epsilon, the previous two inequalities contradict each other, so no SIZE(L^c) function lies in the pullback property P_N.
For uniformly random f, f|U_N is uniform on {0,1}^{U_N}; hence the pullback density equals delta_N.
If delta_N>=2^{-O(L)} and the verifier is 2^{O(L)}-constructive, P_N is a classical natural property useful against SIZE(L^c).

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: SCov-source theorem gap: no explicit advice-free generated row/proof family is known that proves SCov_m(T)>theta on kappa-dense lengths with bounded D and without becoming a large constructive property.
steps: Define SCov_m(T) as the minimum exponent alpha over semantic covers with total summary volume and shared opener/locator size at most 2^{alpha m+o(m)}.
Cover-to-circuit direction: hardwire all summaries, use the rankable block locator to select the relevant summary, and run the opener; the unrestricted circuit size is 2^{max(v,omega)m+o(m)}.
Circuit-to-cover direction: use a one-block cover whose summary is a size-s circuit for T and whose opener is a universal circuit evaluator; this gives SCov_m(T)<=log_2(s)/m+o(1).
Thus SCov_m(T)=log_2 C(T)/m+o(1) for the route's unrestricted circuit model, assuming locator overhead is included in the opener.

Plugging the MCSP no-side threshold C(T)>2^{theta m} into the existing low-D, kappa-dense carrier extraction gives the already valid transfer delta<theta/(kappa(1+D)), but only after the SCov gate is passed.

Therefore semantic-cover leakage is not an auxiliary nuisance: any subthreshold cover is a finite falsifier, while a high-SCov certificate is essentially the row lower-bound certificate the route still lacks.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a route-level normal form and falsifier theorem. It does not construct a high-SCov row, does not prove an E lower bound unconditionally, and does not resolve P != NP.

assumptions: MCSP hardness is measured in the unrestricted nonuniform circuit model; hardwiring summaries is allowed when deriving an upper-bound falsifier.
The opener includes block location, summary addressing, and bit decoding; its exponent omega absorbs polynomial and polylogarithmic overheads.
The cover family may use one block whose summary is a circuit description; hence ordinary circuits embed into the semantic-cover model.
The E extraction uses only canonical low-D image enumeration and does not use advice, nonuniform length selection, or a hard-row oracle.
definitions: source object: An advice-free generated anti-ball MCSP carrier G_m whose accepted image contains at most 2^{D m+o(m)} distinct truth-table rows T in {0,1}^{2^m} and claims row hardness above 2^{theta m}.
target object: An E-uniform language L extracted from kappa-dense source lengths, with target consequence SIZE_L(n)>2^{delta n} against unrestricted Boolean circuits.

controlled interface: A semantic cover is a rankable block decomposition of {0,1}^m, per-block hardwirable summaries of total volume 2^{v m+o(m)}, and a shared opener/locator circuit of size 2^{omega m+o(m)} outputting T(x).

target-preserving condition: The extraction is valid only when generation and canonical image unranking are E-uniform and advice-free, the image entropy is D, source lengths are kappa-dense, and every accepted row has semantic-cover exponent at least theta-o(1).

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Exhibit any one-block circuit cover, hierarchical block-summary cover, proof skeleton opener, or semantic cover with exponent below theta; that invalidates the source rather than merely weakening extraction.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Normal-form gate and finite falsifier for generated MCSP carrier sources.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Semantic-cover dimension is an exact normal form for unrestricted MCSP row hardness up to o(1) in the exponent. If a generated carrier row T has a semantic cover of exponent alpha<theta, this is a valid falsifier for the claimed MCSP no-side threshold 2^{theta m}; conversely, proving semantic-cover dimension above theta already implies the needed unrestricted row lower bound.

assumptions: Usefulness means P_m contains no truth table computed by circuits of size 2^{theta m}.
Constructivity means membership in P_m is decidable in poly(N) time from the full truth table.
Largeness means |P_m|/2^N is at least inverse-polynomial or otherwise natural-size, not the sparse 2^{D m}/2^N generated image regime.
This is a route barrier audit, not an unconditional lower-bound impossibility theorem.
definitions: source object: A projected row property P_m obtained from a generated proof family by forgetting proof location and retaining only accepted truth tables T in {0,1}^N, N=2^m.
target object: A truth-table lower-bound property useful against SIZE(2^{theta m}) and intended to feed the MCSP carrier extraction.
controlled interface: Projection from generated row/proof pairs to accepted rows, plus a truth-table decision procedure for membership in P_m.
target-preserving condition: The projection remains target-preserving only if it avoids simultaneous largeness, poly(N)-constructivity, and usefulness against the target circuit class.

equations.label: natural_projection_pattern
equations.valid_when: Valid when the projected property is poly(N)-decidable from truth tables and large in the natural-property sense.

equations.label: sparse_generated_measure
equations.valid_when: Valid when the generated carrier has D m plus lower-order bits of distinct-image entropy.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If the repair makes high-cover certification dense and poly(N)-decidable while preserving circuit exclusion, mark it as a natural-property falsifier unless it supplies an explicit non-natural escape.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Barrier-interface classifier for dense projection repairs of the semantic-cover source.
candidate_lemmas.statement: A repair that turns sparse generated high-SCov certificates into a large poly(N)-decidable row property while still excluding all circuits of size 2^{theta m} becomes a useful natural-property object. The valid escape is sparse proof-mediated generation, super-polynomial truth-table constructivity, or another explicitly non-large projection.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot or quarantine if every proposed high-SCov certificate either uses advice, becomes dense and poly(N)-decidable, or merely assumes the target MCSP lower bound.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote if the SCov normal-form theorem, dense-projection classifier, and finite falsifier list survive prior-art checking and can be stated as a scoped MCSP-carrier obstruction.
control_decision.reason: The branch made route-level progress by deriving an exact cover/circuit equivalence and a sharper falsifier. The remaining work is source construction or a scoped no-go, not another transfer restatement.

dependency_updates.description: SCov_m(T) equals the unrestricted circuit exponent up to o(1) once one-block universal covers and cover-to-circuit hardwiring are included.
dependency_updates.status: added; needs prior-art boundary and notation audit

dependency_updates.description: A valid generated MCSP carrier must now prove high semantic-cover dimension, not only avoid local, skip-ahead, checkpoint, or block-summary leakage.
The low-D kappa-dense extraction to E lower bounds remains delta<theta/(kappa(1+D)) after the SCov gate is satisfied.
Dense poly(N)-decidable projections of high-SCov certification become useful natural properties; sparse generated projections remain outside largeness but still need soundness.

falsifiers: A one-block universal-circuit cover of exponent alpha<theta is an immediate falsifier for the claimed MCSP no-side row.
Any rankable block-summary cover with total summary volume 2^{v m} and opener size 2^{omega m}, max(v,omega)<theta, invalidates the source.
A compressed proof skeleton with an indexed row opener below theta is a nonuniform circuit upper bound, not a valid carrier.
A dense poly(N)-decidable projection that excludes small circuits is a natural-property barrier object unless a non-natural escape is formally supplied.
A hard-row selector using advice, nonuniform length choice, or an unsearchable proof location fails the target-preserving E extraction.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: If some lambda gives alpha(lambda)<theta, the row has a small unrestricted circuit and the carrier is falsified. If no such lambda is found, the observation is only evidence for high semantic-cover dimension, not a proof of MCSP hardness.
held_fixed_controls: The claimed MCSP threshold remains 2^{theta m} against unrestricted nonuniform circuits.
The extracted language must remain E-uniform, advice-free, kappa-dense, and have distinct-image entropy D.
The row/proof generator is not allowed to introduce a separate indexed opener below theta.
The target consequence remains only the conditional E lower bound delta<theta/(kappa(1+D)).
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The branch now needs a concrete semantic-cover stress test because sequential and skip-hard generation alone no longer certify row hardness; the decisive issue is whether the row has any hardwirable cover below theta.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: Take a generated anti-ball carrier row T_m and impose a rankable partition into 2^{(1-lambda)m} intervals, each with a semantic summary of length 2^{mu m}, plus a shared opener of size 2^{omega m}.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A formal cover-to-circuit construction including locator overhead, plus a proof that the same row family passes low-D canonical unranking and kappa-density without advice.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: lambda, the block-length exponent, varied while optimizing the induced cover exponent alpha(lambda)=max{1-lambda+mu(lambda),omega(lambda)}.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 71 turns semantic block-cover leakage into an exponent-normal-form statement: avoiding all such covers is equivalent, up to o(1), to the unrestricted MCSP row lower bound. This sharpens the route by converting many leakage checks into one finite falsifier gate, while preserving the distinction between a valid conditional carrier transfer and an actual proof of P != NP.

negative_tactic_decision.conflict_target: Claim of language hardness from a carrier that may only identify nonuniform hard rows or rows with hidden semantic covers below theta.
negative_tactic_decision.contradiction_carrier_or_no_go_family: A subthreshold semantic cover, one-block circuit cover, compressed proof skeleton, or advice-based selector that yields an unrestricted circuit for the claimed hard row.
escape_conditions: Explicit advice-free row-hard certificate proving SCov_m(T)>theta-o(1).
Searchable certificate and canonical row selection within E, with bounded distinct-image entropy D.
Sparse or proof-mediated projection that avoids natural-property largeness pressure.
No indexed opener, block-summary cover, skip-ahead mechanism, or nonuniform selector below theta.
negative_tactic_decision.exact_negation_or_method_class: Generated MCSP/MKtP anti-ball certificate carriers, hard-row selectors, truth-table ranking mechanisms, semantic covers, and indexed proof openings.
negative_tactic_decision.next_validation_handoff: Send the SCov normal-form packet to pvsnp-symbolic-complexity-auditor for parameter checking, then to pvsnp-impossibility-theorem-forger for prior-art and no-go boundary validation.
negative_tactic_decision.paper_contribution_potential: Potential paper-level stepping stone if framed as a semantic-cover normal form plus finite falsifier suite for MCSP carrier transfers, with explicit escape conditions.
proof_obligations: Name the truth-table family T_m, row selector, verifier, certificate size, image entropy D, and kappa-density window.
Prove the verifier's accepted rows have SCov_m(T)>theta-o(1), not merely no known local opener.
Check whether selection uses advice, ranking, or nonuniform hard-string choice.
Run easy sparse tables, one-block circuit covers, and low-complexity rows as falsifiers.
Record whether any projection repair is large, poly(N)-decidable, and useful against SIZE(2^{theta m}).
negative_tactic_decision.reason_for_tactic: The live risk is that the carrier supplies only advice-selected or semantically compressed hard-looking rows; the SCov normal form gives a direct nonuniform upper-bound test.
